nodes.label: Authentication & RBAC Domain
nodes.description: User identity, registration, JWT session issuance, and role-based access control.

nodes.label: Continuous Judging & Voting Domain
nodes.description: One-video-at-a-time evaluation loop, numeric scoring (1-5), and consensus calculation.

nodes.label: Creator Submissions Domain
nodes.description: Creator video uploading, validation, and submission status lifecycle tracking.

nodes.label: Contest Management Domain
nodes.description: Contest lifecycle scheduling, categories, prize pools, and state transitions.

nodes.label: Content Moderation & Auditing Domain
nodes.description: Split-viewer video inspection, rejection feedback, and append-only audit logging.

nodes.label: Dynamic Leaderboard Domain
nodes.description: Community score aggregation, podium top 3 ranking, and category filtering.

nodes.label: Multi-Tenancy & Brand Customization Domain
nodes.description: Brand tenant provisioning, theme customizer, and organization data isolation.

nodes.label: Visitor / Voter Persona
nodes.description: Public community member evaluating competing video entries.

nodes.label: Content Creator Persona
nodes.description: Authenticated user uploading video entries to compete in contests.

nodes.label: Brand Administrator Persona
nodes.description: Organization manager configuring branded contests and moderating submissions.

nodes.label: Platform Super Administrator Persona
nodes.description: Global platform operator managing tenant provisioning and cross-brand governance.

nodes.label: Rate Contest Video
nodes.description: Permission to cast a 1-5 numerical score on candidate contest submissions.

nodes.label: Upload Contest Video
nodes.description: Permission to submit original video entries into active contests.

nodes.label: Moderate Submissions
nodes.description: Permission to approve or reject pending video submissions.

nodes.label: Create & Manage Contests
nodes.description: Permission to create contest instances, configure schedules, and define prize pools.

nodes.label: Manage Platform Tenants
nodes.description: Permission to provision, configure, or suspend brand organizations.

nodes.label: Continuous Video Judging Queue
nodes.description: Focused single-video vertical player queue with auto-advance and keyboard navigation. Loads approved entries from the judging queue API.

nodes.label: Creator Video Upload Hub
nodes.description: Modal wizard for uploading MP4/WebM videos with validation and metadata tags.

nodes.label: Split-Screen Moderation Viewer
nodes.description: Dual-pane inspection UI. Approve and reject call the moderation APIs.

nodes.label: Dynamic Leaderboard & Podium
nodes.description: Visual top 3 podium and paginated ranking table with real-time score updates.

nodes.label: Multi-Tenant Dynamic Theming
nodes.description: Live customizer for brand color palettes, typography, logos, and banners. Save persists Organization.branding. Suspension overlay remains local until M10.

nodes.label: Visitor Judging & Rating Loop
nodes.description: Watch Video -> Rate [1-5] -> Reveal Consensus Score -> Auto-Advance to Next Video.

nodes.label: Creator Video Submission Flow
nodes.description: Register -> Open Modal -> Upload Video -> Validate -> Submit to Moderation Queue.

nodes.label: Administrator Moderation Flow
nodes.description: Load Queue -> Inspect in Split Viewer -> Approve/Reject -> Log Audit Record.

nodes.label: ViewerContainer Component
nodes.description: Root Next.js container rendering continuous judging loop with overlays.

nodes.label: RatingBar Component
nodes.description: 1-5 star/numeric rating widget with hotkey badges.

nodes.label: ScoreRevealOverlay Component
nodes.description: 1.8s consensus reveal animation with progress bar.

nodes.label: UploadModal Component
nodes.description: Creator video upload wizard with validation and preview.

nodes.label: SubmissionsTable Component
nodes.description: Creator dashboard table listing submission statuses, scores, and actions.

nodes.label: ModerationSplitViewer Component
nodes.description: Split-pane admin review UI with video inspection and decision buttons.

nodes.label: RejectReasonDialog Component
nodes.description: Dialog capturing categorized rejection reasons and feedback notes.

nodes.label: LeaderboardPodium Component
nodes.description: Top 3 ranked submission podium cards.

nodes.label: BrandThemeForm Component
nodes.description: Theme customizer form for brand palettes, fonts, and assets.

nodes.label: useContestQueue Hook
nodes.description: Loads the approved judging queue, posts ratings, and reveals the server score for Contest.autoAdvanceDelayMs.

nodes.label: useCreatorSubmissions Hook
nodes.description: Loads GET /submissions/me and soft-deletes through DELETE /submissions/:id after confirmation. Metrics are derived from API rows.

nodes.label: useTenantTheme Hook
nodes.description: Loads branding by the active slug from GET /organizations/:slug/branding and applies CSS variables. API status feeds activeBrand.status for the suspension overlay (M10). localStorage catalog is a fallback and optional cache.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/auth/register/creator
nodes.description: Registers a new Creator account, assigns the deployment organization from DEPLOYMENT_ORGANIZATION_SLUG, and issues a JWT. Per-IP rate limit 10/15min; sanitizeUser strips passwordHash.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/auth/register/brand
nodes.description: Historical brand-registration contract. The customer-facing HTTP route was removed on 2026-09-29. AuthService.registerBrand remains for internal use. See docs/knowledge/deployment-model.md.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/auth/login
nodes.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns JWT token. M12: per-IP engineering rate limit 10/15min; sanitizeUser strips passwordHash. Expiry remains 7d.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/auth/me
nodes.description: Returns profile payload of currently authenticated user. Any authenticated Prisma Role. Unauthenticated → 401.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/users
nodes.description: Paginated user list. SUPER_ADMIN only (M03-P01-T02). Unauthenticated → 401. Other roles including BRAND_ADMIN → 403. Org-scoped list NOT SPECIFIED.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/users/:id
nodes.description: User profile by id. SUPER_ADMIN only. Self-profile remains GET /auth/me. Unauthenticated → 401. Other roles → 403.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/contests/:id/videos/:videoId/rate
nodes.description: Optional auth. Anonymous or VIEWER. Returns previousScore, newScore, delta, totalVotes. Contest must be ACTIVE or JUDGING. Submission must be APPROVED. M12: per-IP engineering rate limit 60/minute. Duplicate-vote window remains NOT SPECIFIED.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/submissions/presign
nodes.description: CREATOR-only. Issues a presigned S3 PUT URL when the contest is ACTIVE and belongs to the creator organization. A foreign contest is rejected before signing. Fastify never receives video bytes.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/submissions/complete
nodes.description: CREATOR-only. Persists PENDING_REVIEW after the client PUT to S3. objectKey must be backend-issued.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/submissions/me
nodes.description: CREATOR-only list of the authenticated creator submissions.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/submissions/:id
nodes.description: CREATOR-only. Returns the caller's submission or 404.

nodes.label: DELETE /api/v1/submissions/:id
nodes.description: CREATOR-only soft delete of the caller's submission. Sets deletedAt and deletedById. Does not remove ratings or the stored video.

nodes.label: SubmissionService
nodes.description: Validates ACTIVE contest, MP4/WebM, 100MB, 60s metadata. Issues object keys and persists PENDING_REVIEW.

nodes.label: SubmissionRepository
nodes.description: Prisma create, findById, findByObjectKey, listByCreatorId, and creator softDeleteOwned. Public lists omit deletedAt rows.

nodes.label: StorageService / S3StorageAdapter
nodes.description: Presigned PUT abstraction. Production adapter is S3StorageAdapter for private bucket woofskis-production-media in us-east-2. There is no local-demo provider and no disk fallback. Fastify does not receive video bytes.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/admin/submissions/:id/approve
nodes.description: Approves a PENDING_REVIEW submission and writes an AuditLog APPROVE row.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/admin/submissions/:id/reject
nodes.description: Rejects a PENDING_REVIEW submission. reason is required. Writes AuditLog REJECT.

nodes.label: AuthService
nodes.description: Business logic for hashing passwords, issuing JWTs, and validating registration.

nodes.label: UserService
nodes.description: Business logic for user lookups and profile retrieval.

nodes.label: JudgingService
nodes.description: Queue of APPROVED submissions and transactional community-score updates. Voting window is ACTIVE and JUDGING.

nodes.label: UserRepository
nodes.description: Prisma data access methods for User and Organization models.

nodes.label: OrganizationService
nodes.description: Branding reads, BRAND_ADMIN own-organization write checks, and M10 SUPER_ADMIN list/suspend/reinstate. SUPER_ADMIN may update any organization. No delete or slug mutation.

nodes.label: OrganizationRepository
nodes.description: Prisma access for organization findById, findBySlug, findAll (SUPER_ADMIN list), branding replacement, suspend, and reinstate.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/organizations/:slug/branding
nodes.description: Public branding read by slug. No authenticate hook. Missing slug returns 404. branding may be null.

nodes.label: PUT /api/v1/organizations/:id/branding
nodes.description: Replace branding JSON. BRAND_ADMIN own organization or SUPER_ADMIN. Cross-tenant write is 403. primaryColor and logoUrl required.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/super-admin/organizations
nodes.description: M10-P01-T01. SUPER_ADMIN-only list of every organization (id, name, slug, branding, createdAt, updatedAt). BRAND_ADMIN, CREATOR, VIEWER 403; missing/invalid token 401; any query key 400. No pagination, filter, or suspension status.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/super-admin/organizations/:id/suspend
nodes.description: M10-P01-T02. SUPER_ADMIN only. Body { reason } (required free text). Sets status SUSPENDED, suspendedAt now, suspensionReason. Unknown org 404, already suspended 409, blank reason 400. No AuditLog row.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/super-admin/organizations/:id/reinstate
nodes.description: M10-P01-T03. SUPER_ADMIN only. No body. Sets status ACTIVE and clears suspendedAt and suspensionReason. Unknown org 404, not suspended 409.

nodes.label: Super Admin Platform Radar Page
nodes.description: /super-admin. Tenant fleet from GET /super-admin/organizations with loading, error, and empty states. Suspend opens a reason dialog; Reactivate calls reinstate. Compliance notices remain a local prototype.

nodes.label: useSuperAdminOrganizations Hook
nodes.description: Loads the SUPER_ADMIN organization list and runs suspend/reinstate through super-admin-api.ts. Surfaces load and action errors from the API envelope.

nodes.label: Suspend Organization Dialog
nodes.description: Collects the required free-text suspension reason. No preset reason categories (no taxonomy).

nodes.label: LoginForm Component
nodes.description: Email/password login UI wired to POST /api/v1/auth/login; stores real JWT in STORAGE_KEYS.AUTH_TOKEN.

nodes.label: CreatorRegisterForm Component
nodes.description: Creator registration UI. Maps fullName to name; does not POST handle/username/avatarUrl.

nodes.label: BrandRegisterForm Component
nodes.description: Brand registration form is not mounted. /register/brand redirects to /login. Admins are pre-provisioned for the deployment organization.

nodes.label: useAuthSession Hook
nodes.description: Client session: live auth API, JWT persistence, GET /auth/me hydration. Demo/mock login gated out of the production path.

nodes.label: RoleGuard Component
nodes.description: Dashboard route guard. Reads Redux session role (M02 aliases ORGANIZATION_ADMIN/PLATFORM_ADMIN) after GET /auth/me hydration. Protects /creator, /admin/moderation, /admin/contests, /admin/brands, /super-admin.

nodes.label: User Database Model
nodes.description: Prisma entity storing authenticated user credentials, role, and organization link.

nodes.label: Organization Database Model
nodes.description: Prisma entity storing tenant identity, slug, JSON branding metadata, and M10 suspension state (status ACTIVE|SUSPENDED, suspendedAt, suspensionReason).

nodes.label: Contest Database Model
nodes.description: Prisma contest: organization, optional category, status, dates, prizeSummary, rules, autoAdvanceDelayMs. Has submissions relation (M06).

nodes.label: Category Database Model
nodes.description: Organization-scoped contest category. Slug is unique per organization.

nodes.label: ContestService
nodes.description: Contest create, list, get, and patch. Enforces one-step lifecycle, ACTIVE settings lock, and BRAND_ADMIN organization scope.

nodes.label: ContestRepository
nodes.description: Prisma CRUD and list by organization, status, and category slug.

nodes.label: CategoryRepository
nodes.description: Create and list categories for one organization. No category HTTP API.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/contests
nodes.description: Admin contest list. BRAND_ADMIN is limited to their organization. CREATOR is rejected. SUPER_ADMIN may filter by tenantId, status, and category slug.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/contests/active
nodes.description: Public list of ACTIVE contests for the deployment organization resolved from DEPLOYMENT_ORGANIZATION_SLUG. No auth. Guest and creator discovery use this instead of a tenant catalog.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/contests
nodes.description: Create a DRAFT contest. BRAND_ADMIN own organization or SUPER_ADMIN.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/contests/banners/presign
nodes.description: ADMIN presigns a private contest banner PUT. The contest stores bannerObjectKey. The bucket stays private.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/contests/:id
nodes.description: Get one contest. BRAND_ADMIN cannot read another organization's contest.

nodes.label: PATCH /api/v1/contests/:id
nodes.description: Update contest metadata or move one lifecycle step. ACTIVE settings lock and closed-contest read-only rules apply.

nodes.label: useContestsManagement Hook
nodes.description: Admin contest list, create, and status transitions via the contests API. localStorage is not the primary source.

nodes.label: Submission Database Model
nodes.description: Prisma submission: contest, creator, title, videoUrl, unique objectKey, optional thumbnailUrl, durationSeconds, PENDING_REVIEW default, tags, communityScore, totalVotes, nullable deletedAt and deletedById.

nodes.label: Rating Database Model
nodes.description: Individual ratings. New votes are integers 1-10. Historical 1-5 rows stay valid. userId and voterFingerprint are optional. Duplicate-vote window is NOT SPECIFIED.

nodes.label: AuditLog Database Model
nodes.description: Append-only audit row: actor, action, optional reason, metadata, createdAt. Retention is NOT SPECIFIED.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/admin/moderation/queue
nodes.description: PENDING_REVIEW queue. BRAND_ADMIN is organization-scoped. SUPER_ADMIN is cross-tenant.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/admin/moderation/audit-logs
nodes.description: Append-only moderation audit history, tenant-scoped like the queue.

nodes.label: ModerationService
nodes.description: Approve, reject, and flag from PENDING_REVIEW inside a transaction with an audit row.

nodes.label: AuditLogRepository
nodes.description: Append-only create and list. No update or delete.

nodes.label: useModerationQueue Hook
nodes.description: Loads the pending queue and audit logs from the M07 APIs and submits approve/reject.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/contests/:id/queue
nodes.description: Public approved judging queue. ACTIVE or JUDGING only. Display order is createdAt then id. Not a leaderboard.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/submissions/:id/share-preview
nodes.description: Public link preview metadata (title, description, thumbnailUrl, creatorName) for an APPROVED, non-deleted submission in a viewable contest. Feeds Open Graph tags on /?v=<id>.

nodes.label: RatingRepository
nodes.description: Locks a submission, inserts a Rating, and writes communityScore and totalVotes in one transaction.

nodes.label: LeaderboardService
nodes.description: Aggregates approved submissions, computes podium (top 3) and ranked entries by communityScore and totalVotes.

nodes.label: useLeaderboard Hook
nodes.description: Fetches GET /contests/:id/leaderboard when a contest UUID is known. Does not fall back to mock rankings. Public contest discovery is NOT SPECIFIED.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/contests/:id/leaderboard
nodes.description: Public contest leaderboard with merit-based communityScore ranking and top-3 podium aggregation.

nodes.label: Route rate limit
nodes.description: In-memory @fastify/rate-limit. Auth writes 10 per 15 minutes per IP per route. Rating POST 60 per minute per IP. Engineering defaults, not business-rule thresholds. Redis and trustProxy are not used.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/health
nodes.description: Public health check. Frozen envelope. data.status is healthy plus an ISO timestamp. Does not probe Prisma. Database readiness on this route is NOT SPECIFIED.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/
nodes.description: Public root. data.name is Contest Operating System Backend. data.version is 1.0.0. Frozen envelope.

nodes.label: Manage Creator Friends
nodes.description: Active CREATOR accounts may search creators and manage friend requests. Guests and ADMIN are denied. Not specified in the source chapters.

nodes.label: Friendship Database Model
nodes.description: One unordered creator pair. PENDING or ACCEPTED. Unique (userLowId, userHighId) plus a check that the requester is one of the two users.

nodes.label: FriendshipService
nodes.description: Send, accept, reject, cancel, remove, list, and search. Does not call contest, submission, judging, or leaderboard services.

nodes.label: FriendshipRepository
nodes.description: Prisma access for friendships and active-creator name search.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/friends
nodes.description: Accepted friends plus incoming and outgoing requests. CREATOR only.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/friends/search
nodes.description: Name search of active creators. Email is not returned. CREATOR only.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/friends/requests
nodes.description: Send a friend request. Self, duplicate, and already-friends requests are rejected. CREATOR only.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/friends/requests/:id/accept
nodes.description: Recipient accepts a pending request. CREATOR only.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/friends/requests/:id/reject
nodes.description: Recipient rejects a pending request. The row is deleted. CREATOR only.

nodes.label: DELETE /api/v1/friends/requests/:id
nodes.description: Sender cancels a pending request. CREATOR only.

nodes.label: DELETE /api/v1/friends/:id
nodes.description: Either friend removes an accepted friendship. CREATOR only.

nodes.label: FriendsPanel
nodes.description: Creator friends page: search, incoming, outgoing, and accepted friends.

nodes.label: useCreatorFriends
nodes.description: Loads and mutates creator friend requests.

nodes.label: Creator Friend Chat
nodes.description: Active CREATOR accounts may message accepted friends. Guests and ADMIN are denied. Not specified in the source chapters.

nodes.label: Creator Friend Chat
nodes.description: One-to-one text, emoji, and private image or video messages between accepted friends.

nodes.label: ChatMessage
nodes.description: A text or private attachment message on an accepted friendship.

nodes.label: ChatRead
nodes.description: Per-creator read cursor for one friendship.

nodes.label: ChatService
nodes.description: Accepted-friend messaging, unread counts, read cursors, and private attachment presign.

nodes.label: ChatRepository
nodes.description: Prisma access for chat messages and read cursors.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/chat/conversations
nodes.description: Conversation list with preview, timestamp, and unread count. CREATOR only.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/chat/conversations/:id/messages
nodes.description: History for one accepted friendship. CREATOR only.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/chat/conversations/:id/messages
nodes.description: Send text, emoji, or a private attachment. CREATOR only.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/chat/attachments/presign
nodes.description: Presigned PUT for a private chat image or video. CREATOR only.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/chat/stream
nodes.description: Server-sent events for messages and read receipts. CREATOR only.

nodes.label: CreatorChat
nodes.description: Conversation list and thread, including emoji, attachments, unread, and reconnect state.

nodes.label: useCreatorChat
nodes.description: Loads conversations and history, sends messages, and applies the SSE stream.

Rejects submission with reason code.
Logs approval action in AuditLog table.

BrandRegisterForm submits registration through useAuthSession.registerBrand.

SUPER_ADMIN user lookup is handled by UserService.getUserProfile.

OrganizationRepository reads Organization and replaces branding JSON.

Save submits primaryColor, logoUrl, and optional accent and tagline.

Banner presign is handled by ContestService.
Contest read is handled by ContestService.
Contest update and status transition are handled by ContestService.

ContestService resolves categories through CategoryRepository.
ContestRepository reads and writes Contest rows.
CategoryRepository reads and writes Category rows.

Every category belongs to one organization.

Create modal submits POST /contests.
Metadata edits and status actions submit PATCH /contests/:id.
Upload modal requests a presigned S3 PUT URL.
After the S3 PUT, the modal registers PENDING_REVIEW metadata.
Presign is handled by SubmissionService.
Creator list is handled by SubmissionService.
Owner get-by-id is handled by SubmissionService.
SubmissionService persists through SubmissionRepository.
SubmissionService signs uploads through StorageService.
SubmissionRepository reads and writes Submission rows.
Every submission belongs to one creator user.
Split viewer decisions are submitted by useModerationQueue.
Loads PENDING_REVIEW submissions for the signed-in admin.
Loads moderation audit history for the audit modal.
Queue is handled by ModerationService.
Approve is handled by ModerationService.
Reject is handled by ModerationService.
Audit list is handled by ModerationService.
Each decision appends an AuditLog row.
Decisions update Submission status through SubmissionRepository.
AuditLogRepository appends audit_logs rows.
Loads approved submissions for the selected contest.
Queue reads are handled by JudgingService.
Share preview reads are handled by JudgingService.getSharePreview.
Ratings are inserted and scores are written through RatingRepository.
RatingRepository inserts ratings rows.
The same transaction updates Submission.communityScore and totalVotes.
Fetches ranked leaderboard entries for the selected contest.
Leaderboard reads are handled by LeaderboardService.
Queries approved submissions for contest leaderboard rankings.
Leaderboard podium and rankings consume data from useLeaderboard hook.
Tenant list is handled by OrganizationService.listOrganizations.
Route guard authorizeRoles(SUPER_ADMIN); the only role holding manage_tenants.
Suspend is handled by OrganizationService.suspendOrganization.
Reinstate is handled by OrganizationService.reinstateOrganization.
Route guard authorizeRoles(SUPER_ADMIN).
Route guard authorizeRoles(SUPER_ADMIN).
Loads the tenant fleet.
Sends { reason } from the suspend dialog.
Reactivate button.
Fleet grid and suspension controls use the hook.
Suspend opens the reason dialog.
Login uses the auth engineering rate limit.
Creator register uses the auth engineering rate limit.
Historical. Brand registration is no longer on the auth rate-limit counter.
Rating POST uses the rating engineering rate limit.
Creator delete dialog calls DELETE after confirmation.
Creator soft delete is handled by SubmissionService.remove.
Only the CREATOR role may use friend routes. ADMIN is not granted this permission.
Route guard is creatorGuards.
Route guard is creatorGuards.
List is handled by FriendshipService.list.
Search is handled by FriendshipService.search.
Send is handled by FriendshipService.sendRequest.
Accept is handled by FriendshipService.accept.
Reject is handled by FriendshipService.reject.
Cancel is handled by FriendshipService.cancel.
Remove is handled by FriendshipService.remove.
Persistence goes through FriendshipRepository.

Friends page loads the list.
Add friend sends a request.
The friends panel renders search results and request status from the hook.
Only the CREATOR role may use chat. ADMIN is not granted this permission.

Send is handled by ChatService.sendMessage.
ChatService persists messages and read cursors through ChatRepository.
Messages are stored on chat_messages.
Read cursors are stored on chat_reads.
The chat screen renders the hook.
The inbox loads conversations.
The composer sends a message.
The hook keeps a server-sent event stream open.
